name: AISongsMaker
summary: Generates songs from an idea or lyrics, with a free 30-credit start and Starter, Creator and Studio plans that show both monthly and yearly prices.
description: AISongsMaker is an AI music generator with covers, stems, extend/replace tools and MP3/WAV export. The page also advertises a TAAFT-linked Black Friday promo; only the standard official plan prices above are recorded here.

pricing.details: Free (30 credits once). Starter 11 €/month or 96 €/year; Creator 18 €/month or 160 €/year (commercial use, songs kept forever); Studio 45 €/month or 321 €/year.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Songs from an idea or lyrics, plus covers and stems
Commercial use on Creator and Studio
